tools.name: runheed_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Creates a project in the workspace and returns its DSN: the value an app sets as the RUNHEED_DSN environment variable so that runheed.init() reports its errors to this project.

name.description: Project name, usually the app or service name, for example shop-api

slug.description: Optional URL-safe slug; derived from the name when left out

tools.name: runheed_get_error
tools.title: Get an error
tools.description: Returns one error group in full: message, status, counts, first and last seen, environment, agent context, the top stack frames and the latest breadcrumbs. If the error came back after it was marked resolved, it also shows the note it was resolved with, so you can see what the last fix tried. For a resolved error it reports whether the fix held: events since, releases deployed since and whether the fixing commit is live.

errorId.description: The error ID to get details for

tools.name: runheed_get_error_context
tools.title: Get error context
tools.description: Returns everything recorded around an error: every breadcrumb, platform, runtime, OS, environment, release, the affected user, the agent session and extra data.

errorId.description: The error ID to get context for

tools.name: runheed_get_project_health
tools.title: Get project health
tools.description: Returns a 0 to 100 health score for a project (or the whole workspace), errors in the last 24 hours, the unresolved count, the error rate, recent issues and recommendations.

projectId.description: Project id or slug (e.g. shop-api); all projects if not specified

tools.name: runheed_get_recent
tools.title: Get recent errors
tools.description: Returns the error groups seen most recently, newest first, with status, type, message, route, top stack frame, event count, last-seen time and ID.

limit.description: Number of recent errors to return

projectId.description: Filter by project id or slug (e.g. shop-api)

tools.name: runheed_get_trends
tools.title: Get error trends
tools.description: Returns error statistics for the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days: total, new and resolved counts, the most frequent errors and the hourly error rate.

projectId.description: Filter by project id or slug (e.g. shop-api)

tools.name: runheed_ignore_error
tools.title: Ignore an error
tools.description: Marks one error group ignored (errorId), or up to 100 at once (errorIds), for known or expected errors such as browser noise, so new occurrences stop alerting. Returns what changed.

errorIds.description: Several error IDs to ignore with the same reason (up to 100)

tools.name: runheed_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: Lists the workspace's projects with each project's ID, slug, platform and DSN (the value an app sets as RUNHEED_DSN to report errors).

tools.name: runheed_merge_errors
tools.title: Merge duplicate errors
tools.description: Merges error groups that are the same bug into one: their events move to the target group (targetId) and new events with their fingerprints join it too. With groupByMessagePrefix, new events of the target's type whose message starts with that text also join it, for messages that differ only by an ID or a number. Returns what was merged.

errorIds.description: Error groups to merge into the target (same project)

groupByMessagePrefix.description: Optional message prefix: new events of the target's type whose message starts with it are grouped into the target

tools.name: runheed_resolve_error
tools.title: Resolve an error
tools.description: Marks one error group resolved (errorId), or up to 100 at once (errorIds) for duplicates fixed by the same change, with an optional note such as the fixing commit. A group reopens on its own if the error happens again. Returns what changed.

errorIds.description: Several error IDs to resolve with the same note (up to 100)

tools.name: runheed_search_errors
tools.title: Search errors
tools.description: Searches the workspace's error groups by text (type, message, route, file or extra data), status, project and release (including only the errors a release introduced). Returns each matching group with its status, type, message, route, top stack frame, event count, last-seen time and ID.

query.description: Text to find in the error type, message, route, stack frames or extra data, for example a route or a file name

projectId.description: Filter by project id or slug (e.g. shop-api)

release.description: Only errors with an event from this release (the release value the app passes to init, often a commit SHA)

newInRelease.description: With release: only errors that first appeared in that release, to check what a deploy introduced

limit.description: Maximum number of errors to return

tools.name: runheed_send_test_event
tools.title: Send a test event
tools.description: Sends one test error (RunheedTestEvent) to a project through the normal ingest path, which shows whether the project and its send key work. The test error appears in the recent errors and can be resolved like any other.

tools.name: runheed_unignore_error
tools.title: Stop ignoring an error
tools.description: Moves one ignored error group (errorId), or up to 100 (errorIds), back to unresolved, so new occurrences alert again. Returns what changed.

errorIds.description: Several error IDs to unignore (up to 100)
